sources.name: Government.nl governance of Bonaire, St Eustatius and Saba
notes: Official Government of the Netherlands source confirming Bonaire, St Eustatius, and Saba are public bodies of the Netherlands and not part of a Dutch province.

notes: Statistics Netherlands source confirming the country of the Netherlands has European and Caribbean parts and that Caribbean Netherlands comprises Bonaire, Saba, and St Eustatius.
